gate_descriptions.STAGE_5_8_SOURCE_IDENTITY_VERIFIED: The canonical source commit was confirmed; Stage 5.8 did not pass.
gate_descriptions.STAGE_5_8_FAILURES_AND_UNKNOWNS_RETAINED: Negative and unknown outcomes are preserved, not resolved.
gate_descriptions.CURRENT_REPOSITORY_AND_SERVER_BASELINE_V: A point-in-time read-only baseline was confirmed; no commercial service was deployed.
gate_descriptions.PRE_DEVELOPMENT_AGENT_RECOMMENDATION_GAT: The advisory gate completed with NOT_RECOMMENDED and a remediation path.
gate_descriptions.COMMERCIAL_ARCHITECTURE_SPECIFICATION_AD: Specification blockers were remediated and re-reviewed.
gate_descriptions.COMMERCIAL_MULTI_TENANT_VERTICAL_SLICE_I: Gateway main contains the separate PostgreSQL-backed /api/v1 candidate with forced RLS and tenant-bound data paths.
gate_descriptions.COMMERCIAL_POSTGRESQL16_PERSISTENCE_CAND: The existing Baidu host runs the bounded commercial candidate on the retained release; this is not Production Ready.
gate_descriptions.COMMERCIAL_SIGNED_RECEIPT_AND_METERING_I: Signed Receipt, usage, quota and billing-preview paths exist; CR-01 later found two unverifiable historical synthetic Receipts.
gate_descriptions.COMMERCIAL_MACHINE_DISCOVERY_SURFACE_PUB: Machine-readable status, capabilities, plans, OpenAPI and Receipt key discovery are available for the candidate boundary.
gate_descriptions.PUBLIC_SAFE_SDK_AND_ADAPTER_SOURCE_CANDI: titmas-integrations main at 6ed4dadd4693129d3daca0a9a29964a4f7f864e9 contains Python, TypeScript, MCP, LangChain and OpenAI Agents sources with fail-closed authority-boundary validation and a reviewed OpenAPI observation; package registries and production support remain inactive.
gate_descriptions.CR01_BACKUP_INTEGRITY_PASS: The encrypted allowlisted backup passed its internal integrity validation.
gate_descriptions.CR01_STRUCTURAL_RESTORE_PASS_WITH_RECEIP: Isolated restore matched counts, schema, audit tip and 12 forced-RLS tables, but full Receipt verification failed.
gate_descriptions.CR01_FAILURE_EVIDENCE_MERGED: Gateway PR #35 merged the sanitized BLOCKED_LEDGER_INTEGRITY evidence at c319001cc1cf9e44d8b3d0b142a025c6c9af1678.
gate_descriptions.CR01_D02_HOLD_AND_DESIGN_DECISION_RECORD: Human Owner zhangbin accepted CR01-D02 on 2026-07-31. The decision authorizes design only and keeps implementation, a second deployment retry and soak closed.
gate_descriptions.CR01_LEDGER_TRANSITION_DESIGN_REVIEWED: Three role-scoped qwen3.7-max reviews selected immutable exception manifest plus Tenant-scoped anchored clean epochs; the option remains recommended, not authorized.

next_action: Obtain CR01-D03 to authorize or reject Option C implementation and any PR or deployment-cap exception; do not change the Gateway, migrate the database, restart CR-01 or start soak before that decision.
